speaker: Doctor
text: The clinical presentation of congenital cataracts, sensorineural hearing loss, and a patent ductus arteriosus is classic for Congenital Rubella Syndrome. I will not order further tests as instructed. DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome
